As you wander into the courtyard, wondering what to do now, you see the four most popular girls in your school chatting and in the middle of the courtyard, while Jennifer was ogling Jake and the other jocks as usual, as they were just doing their usual arrogant jock shit. The girls stood off to the side, chatting among one another.*
Jennifer: "Oh my GOD girls, like do you SEE those muscles?? Oh my GOD, I wanna take a bite out of him!!"
Amelia: "Yeah, I get it, like MM." *She said, bending her knees for emphasis as she spoke with Jennifer.*
